newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks set record close as bonds, Dow surge.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks set record close as bonds, Dow surge.

text.p: The UK stock market shot to record highs on Friday afternoon after surprisingly weak U.S. employment data sent T-bonds, gilts and Wall Street soaring.
The FTSE 100 index set a new all-time high of 4,025.1 points some 10 minutes before the close of trade, surpassing the previous record set earlier in the week by 0.8 point.
The index drifted back slightly but still set a record closing high of 4,024.8 points, up 24.8 points on the day.
The market had languished below the 4,000 point level until the early afternoon release of the U.S. data showing a surprise 40,000 drop in U.S. non-farm payrolls in September.
